summary: Frontend-only verification of iter251 Phase A/B/C incident_pattern topic packs on /meetings/new. Verified all 11 new topics (5 dump-bed + 6 trucking) load via TopicPicker, prepend the correct EN/ES header to discussion_notes, preserve title parity, and do not leak EN content into ES. Legacy topics without incident_pattern do NOT get the header (regression OK). No JS console errors across desktop (1280px) and mobile (414px).

phase_b_en.dump_bed_overhead_strike: title match + WHAT HAPPENS header + pattern paragraph 'Most overhead strikes happen at the dump site itself' + blank line + bullets '• Before raising the bed — look up.' — ALL PASS

phase_b_c_es.dump_bed_overhead_strike: starts with 'PATRÓN REAL · lo que suele pasar', no EN leakage, ES title 'Golpes de Caja Volcadora — Líneas Aéreas...'
phase_b_c_es.trucking_backing_struck_by: starts with 'PATRÓN REAL · lo que suele pasar', ES title 'Accidentes al Retroceder — Uso de Spotter...'
phase_b_c_es.trucking_kingpin_coupling_failure: starts with ES header, ES title 'Fallas de Kingpin y Acoplamiento del Trailer'

legacy_regression.trenching_shoring: header absent — notes begin '• Competent person inspects every excavation daily...'
legacy_regression.fall_protection: header absent — notes begin '• 100% tie-off above 6 ft in construction.'

test_evidence.viewports: Verified at 1280x900 (desktop) and 414x900 (mobile). dump_bed_overhead_strike loads with EN header on mobile; trucking_backing_struck_by loads with ES header on mobile after lang-es toggle.
test_evidence.console_errors: 0 errors collected via pageerror + console error listeners across all topic loads and lang switches

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: applyTemplate closure depends on lang from useT(); rapid topic-select right after lang-toggle (≤200ms) can race because React hasn't re-rendered TopicPicker's onChange prop yet. In practice users will not switch lang and immediately pick a topic that fast. Not a real-world bug. If main agent wants belt-and-suspenders, derive lang inside applyTemplate from getLang() to use the latest persisted value.

composeNotes is duplicated verbatim between applyTemplate (lines 89-94) and submit (lines 219-224). DRY: extract into module-level helper in meetingTopicLibrary.js or a small util. Low priority — both copies are identical and short.
context_for_next_testing_agent: TopicPicker uses data-testid='topic-picker-trigger' + 'topic-picker-search' (CommandInput) + 'topic-picker-item-<key>'. Discussion notes textarea is 'input-discussion-notes'. Lang toggle: 'lang-en' / 'lang-es'. After lang switch, allow ~500ms before opening the topic picker on slower devices, otherwise the applyTemplate closure may still hold the previous lang. Splash overlay can intercept the first click — use force=True or wait ~1s after page load. Submit-payload swap-back (EN canonical) was not exercised end-to-end because /meetings POST requires 2 photos + signature; the swap-back logic in NewMeeting.jsx submit() mirrors the composeNotes helper exactly so behavior is equivalent — leaving as code-verified.
